description: This file defines interfaces and a record class related to reminders in an Orleans-based testing environment, including reminder state serialization and several grain interfaces for managing reminders.

classes.name: ReminderState
classes.description: A serializable record class representing the state of a reminder, including properties for reminder details, registration times, fired times, and logs.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a reminder with specified parameters, returning a task that yields a GrainReminder object.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder by name or by GrainReminder object.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Gets the due time and period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Retrieves a counter associated with the specified name.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Returns the GrainReminder object corresponding to a reminder name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Returns a list of all GrainReminder objects managed by the grain.

methods.name: GetReminderStates
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping reminder names to their ReminderState.
